tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (12.7:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-sepia
tokens.usage: Aged photographs, warm nostalgia, time passage. Used as background on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.nav-link:hover`; shadow/glow on `.page-title`, `.table-filter:focus`.

tokens.name: color-dark-sepia
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo`, `.page-title`, `.stat-value`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-archive-blue
tokens.usage: Digital technology, trust, preservation reliability. Used as text on `.stat-trend`, `.badge-success`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-faded-rose
tokens.usage: Sentimental warmth, cherished moments, love. Used as shadow/glow on `.card-badge`; background on `.badge-warning`.

tokens.name: color-vintage-cream
tokens.usage: Old paper, gentle backgrounds, timeless elegance. Used as text on `.footer-section-title`, `.footer-link:hover`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-dusty-brown
tokens.usage: Leather-bound albums, heritage, grounded history. Used as background on `body::before`.

tokens.name: color-soft-gray
tokens.usage: Neutral balance, modern clarity, subtle sophistication.

tokens.name: color-warm-copper
tokens.usage: Aged metal, vintage frames, nostalgic accents. Used as background on `.content-card::before`; shadow/glow on `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.header`, `.page-header`, `.content-card`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `th` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.card-meta` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Exquisite collection of cabinet cards, tintypes, and family
styles.usage: Body copy — as `p.card-description` on the reference page.
